args.description: The major device number is an integer number which tells the kernel which device driver entry point to use
args.name: major

args.description: The minor device number tells the kernel which one of several similar devices the node corresponds to; the unit and subunit numbers select a subset of a device; for example, the unit may specify a particular SCSI disk, and the subunit a partition on that disk
args.name: minor | unit subunit
